name: Matheesha Pathirana
why_target: Generational death bowling phenom. 61 clutch wickets and 7.90 pressure economy. Pairs with Sandeep Sharma to form an impenetrable death-overs wall.
risks: Workload management and shoulder/hamstring niggles; will command intense bidding war.

name: Trent Boult
why_target: Legendary Rajasthan Royals powerplay icon returning home. Immediate swing breakthroughs in overs 1–6, relieving pressure on Archer and Shami.
risks: Age 37; diminished impact if pitch offers zero swing.

name: Avesh Khan
why_target: High-pace Indian death bowler with 57 clutch wickets. Protects RR’s overseas slots while delivering 145+ kph wide yorkers and hard bouncers.
risks: Can be expensive when line errs onto pads in small grounds.

name: Mustafizur Rahman
why_target: World’s premier off-cutter and change-of-pace wizard. Exceptional 7.87 pressure economy on abrasive Sawai Mansingh Stadium pitches.
risks: Vulnerable to straight-line power hitting if ball gets wet with dew.

name: Wanindu Hasaranga
why_target: Elite wicket-taking leg-spinner and lower-order boundary striker. Forms a devastating spin partnership with Bishnoi and Jadeja.
risks: Overseas slot competition; occasionally leaks runs when batsmen read his wrong’un.

name: Deepak Chahar
why_target: Premier Indian powerplay swing bowler. Bowls 3 overs upfront with precision seam, adding valuable lower-order batting depth.
risks: Injury history and limited efficacy in death overs (overs 18–20).

name: Maheesh Theekshana
why_target: Carrom-ball mystery spinner offering sub-8 economy in powerplay and death. High dot-ball percentage (42.4%) chokes run rates.
risks: Zero batting ability; fielding mobility concerns.

name: Tushar Deshpande
why_target: Indian domestic seamer with 41 clutch wickets. Dependable middle-overs strike option who knows RR team culture.
risks: High economy rate (10.22 in pressure situations) when under assault.

name: Akash Deep
why_target: Test-proven Indian hit-the-deck fast bowler. Generates steep bounce from back of a length; excellent backup for Shami and Sandeep.

name: Haris Rauf
why_target: 150+ kph express tearaway death spearhead. 43 pressure wickets with 39.7% dot-ball rate; terrifying yorkers in overs 16–20.
risks: Overseas slot utilization; susceptible to ramp/scoop shots against pace.
